surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves the use of diethylzinc (Zn(C2H5)2, DEZ) and water as the zinc and oxygen sources, respectively. The reaction chamber is maintained at 200 °C with a steady N2 stream. Each ALD cycle consists of a 250-ms precursor pulse and 10-s purging time with N2. The growth rate of ALD ZnO is 0.22 nm per cycle, indicating a self-limiting process without significant CVD reactions.
